launchPromise: A local AI agent that shows its work: search, diff preview, Apply, receipt, report.

posts.text: I built AgentTrail, a local AI agent that shows its work. It searches your workspace, previews diffs before writing, requires Apply, and leaves receipts you can inspect or export. Ollama-first, local-first, and readable.

AgentTrail is a tiny local agent layer for auditable runs: workspace search, diff-safe writes, explicit approvals, project memory, recipe packs, and shareable reports. It is designed to be learned from and extended.

responseMacros.privacy: AgentTrail keeps workspace files, receipts, sessions, and memory local by default. With Ollama or a local OpenAI-compatible server, prompts stay on your machine.
responseMacros.safety: AgentTrail is preview-first. It can propose a diff, but Apply is explicit, and the receipt records what happened.
responseMacros.contribution: Good first contributions are small recipes, benchmark fixtures, docs fixes, showcase entries, or plugin examples.
